title: RAG System — AI Document Chatbot
highlights: Chat with PDFs, Word, TXT, CSV, Excel, Markdown, HTML, XML, JSON, and PowerPoint documents
Hybrid retrieval combining BM25 keyword search with FAISS semantic search
Generates context-aware answers with Groq LLMs and source references
shortDesc: An AI-powered document assistant that enables users to chat with documents using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
fullDesc: An AI-powered document assistant that enables users to chat with PDFs, Word files, TXT files, CSVs, Excel files, Markdown, HTML, XML, JSON, PowerPoint files, and other documents using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). The system processes uploaded documents, splits them into chunks, generates embeddings using Sentence Transformers, stores vector embeddings in FAISS, combines semantic retrieval with BM25 keyword search through a hybrid retriever, and uses Groq LLMs to generate context-aware answers with source references.
